entities.summary: Lithuania is a sovereign nation in Northern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Vilnius. Official languages include Lithuanian. Government: Unitary semi-presidential republic. Population: approximately 2.9 million. Area: 65,300 km². Comprehensive index for Lithuania covering Baltic tribes, Grand Duchy of Lithuania (13th-18th century, largest European state by 15th century, Gediminas/Vytautas), Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth (1569-1795, Union of Lublin), Partitions (Russian Empire 1795-1918), national revival (19th century, Vilnius press ban circumvented), independence 1918, interwar republic, Soviet occupation 1940, Nazi occupation 1941-44, Soviet re-occupation 1944-90, Singing Revolution/Sąjūdis, Baltic Way 1989, independence restoration 1990 (first Soviet republic to declare), January Events 1991, EU/NATO 2004.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Lithuania's struggle for independence and its subsequent restoration in 1990 marked a significant turning point in the collapse of Soviet communism, with approximately 2 million people participating in the Singing Revolution and forming the Baltic Way, a 650 km human chain across the country.
